flow: Health and readiness
expected: live200; ready200 only after DB/schema/policy dependencies ready; outage ready503

flow: Anonymous protected endpoint
expected: 401, no record hints

flow: Tenant A programme draft create and read
expected: 201 then 200; actor/tenant server bound; closed payload and ETag

flow: Tenant B reads A record
expected: 404 E_UNAVAILABLE; no title or count leakage

flow: Patch with stale ETag
expected: 409; committed record unchanged

flow: Same idempotency key same request
expected: Same receipt and one effect; reauthorized before replay

flow: Same idempotency key changed request
expected: 409 E_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT; one effect

flow: Grant or membership revoked between first command and retry
expected: Denial within 60s; cached receipt not leaked

flow: Two reviewers use same verified person through aliases
expected: Second or author approval denied; exact snapshot remains unchanged

flow: Upload final chunk first and lose acknowledgement
expected: GET confirms index; identical retry safe; conflicting digest409

flow: Upload expiry or rights loss before finalisation
expected: 410 expiry or403 rights; no available artifact

flow: Whole-object hash mismatch
expected: verification failed; no preview/search/AI/export/use exposure

flow: Abort races finalisation and worker retry
expected: One serialized intent; late worker cannot publish aborted content

flow: Quarantine scan unavailable
expected: Artifact remains quarantined and recoverable; readiness for unrelated workflows preserved

flow: Concurrent budget admission
expected: Only allowed reservations commit; actual overrun still recorded

flow: Transaction fails after state write before outbox
expected: State, receipt, audit and outbox all roll back

flow: Outbox publish succeeds then worker crashes
expected: Same event redelivered; inbox prevents repeated consumer effect

flow: Event gap or tampered event
expected: Park and reconcile/quarantine; no out-of-order state inference

flow: Local device disconnects during policy lease
expected: Local expiry enforced; central remote-unconfirmed until observed stop

flow: Safety intake with no study identifier
expected: Minimal authenticated concern accepted; no dependency on run availability

flow: Support approval expires mid-session
expected: Next request denied; no raw data or signed URL reuse

flow: AI prompt injection requests export or approval
expected: No authority escalation; proposals only; untrusted retrieved text not executable instruction

flow: Restore older backup after revocation or deletion
expected: Restriction ledger applied before serving traffic; revoked asset remains blocked

flow: Missing, zero and suppressed observations
expected: Distinct display and aggregation; unknown never zero

flow: Constrained network, keyboard and screen reader
expected: Resume/no duplicate effects; focus and announcement states correct; source performance targets met
